input.headline: Marketing Coordinator | Content, Email, Events
input.about: Marketing coordinator at a mid-size nonprofit (Harbor Literacy Project). I write our email newsletter, help plan our yearly fundraising gala, and manage our Instagram. I recently finished a Google Analytics certificate and I'm trying to move into product marketing at a tech company. I care a lot about writing that people actually read.

goldFacts: I am a marketing coordinator at Harbor Literacy Project, a nonprofit.
I write the organization's email newsletter.
I help plan the yearly fundraising gala.
I manage the organization's Instagram account.
I completed a Google Analytics certificate.
I want to move into product marketing at a tech company.

traps.text: Directed the annual fundraising gala, coordinating vendors and volunteers.
Experienced with HubSpot and Salesforce marketing automation.
Raised record donations at the yearly gala.

goal: Move into product marketing at a tech company
jobDescription: Product Marketing Associate. You'll write launch messaging, run customer interviews, and work with product managers on positioning. 1-3 years of marketing experience. Strong writing required.
notes: Career switch with a job description. 'help plan' must not become 'directed'.
